Every line cites the cached page it comes from (gg: = GamerGuides DE guide text, fandom:/dqo: = wiki pages). build.py fails if a number is not in the cited page or a [[name]] is not in the game data. sections.title: How to pick the game back up after a break

steps.t: Load your newest save.
Open the main menu.
Find your chapter in the Walkthrough tab of this guide by the last town or dungeon you remember.
Read the chapter's goal line and the party level target.
Open Misc > Character Builder.
Spend any unspent skill points (the Character Builder how-to shows how).
Open the [[Fun-Size Forge]] from the Important Items menu.
Check which recipe books you own.
If the walkthrough level target is above your party, farm with the Level up fast how-to before the next boss.
If you are past [[Calasmos]] in the third act, jump to the Post-game checklist tab.

sections.check: You know your chapter, your party has no unspent points, and you know the next level target.

sections.title: How to spend skill points in the Character Builder
sections.need: You'll need: skill points from levelling up or a [[Seed of Skill]].

steps.t: Open the main menu > Misc > Character Builder.
Pick the character; each block of panels is one weapon or skill type.
Unlock a panel next to one you already own; you can only unlock adjacent panels.
Plan a route toward the panels marked ?; each shows how many surrounding panels it needs before it opens.
Commit to one weapon type per character first; the Party tab lists every panel with its SP cost.
If you chose badly, go to any church or priest.
Pick Rectification there to reset one whole skill type (not single panels).
Pay the reset fee: 20 gold per skill point refunded. Rectification opens once [[Veronica]] and [[Serena]] have joined.

sections.check: The panel lights up and its skill appears in the character's Abilities list.
sections.why: Panels expand after major story events, and at level 99 the only new points come from a [[Seed of Skill]], worth one point each.

sections.title: How to forge a +3 item at the Fun-Size Forge
sections.need: You'll need: the recipe book, the materials (see the item card), and for reworking, [[Perfectionist's pearl]]s.

steps.t: Open the [[Fun-Size Forge]] from the Important Items menu (Definitive Edition lets you forge almost anywhere).
Choose either a new item to craft or rework to improve one you own.
Pick Bash on one square.
Watch its gauge fill.
Stop each gauge inside the green range; aim for the small notch, where the meter turns yellow.
Watch Focus in the bottom left: Bash costs 5 Focus, Flourishes cost more.
Use Flourishes to hit several squares at once; the first one unlocks at Level 10.
If the Master Stroke (Hephaestus' Flame, learned at level 55) appears, use it when a square is close to its notch.
Use Appraise: Pretty well means +1, Really well +2, Brilliantly +3.
Finish with every gauge green for a guaranteed +1.
For a +3 on a new item, get at least half the gauges yellow.
If you fail a rework, nothing is lost: the item keeps its previous bonus.

sections.check: The finished item shows its stat bonus as +1, +2 or +3.
sections.why: Each stat on an item card reads base/+1/+2/+3, so a +3 forge is often worth more than a shop upgrade.

sections.title: How to use Pep Powers
sections.need: You'll need: the right skill panels for combo Pep Powers (see the table on the source page).

steps.t: Fight normally or Guard until a character peps up; the portrait glows.
Watch for the glow to flash: the pepped up state is about to end.
Swap pepped characters out of battle to hold the state while others pep up.
Bring them back for a group Pep Power.
Use a [[Pep pip]] to pep up one character, or a [[Pep pop]] to pep up the whole active party.
Buy a [[Pep pip]] at the Octagonia Casino for 125,000 tokens, or for 10 [[Mini medal]]s each after you hand in 110.
Buy a [[Pep pop]] in Cobblestone in the final part of the game for 200,000G each.

sections.check: The Pep Power appears in the Pep Powers menu of the pepped characters.
sections.why: There are 83 Pep Powers; using 25 unlocks the Peppy-Go-Lucky trophy.

sections.title: How to level up fast with metal slimes
sections.need: You'll need: the [[Luminary]] with [[Pep Up]] (Luminary panels), [[Erik]], [[Jade]], [[Sylvando]], [[Rab]], and a few [[Pep pip]]s.

steps.t: Start a battle against enemies that do not run away with [[Rab]], [[Erik]], [[Jade]] and [[Sylvando]].
Guard with them until all four are pepped up, swapping members in and out as needed.
Bring in the [[Luminary]].
Use [[Pep Up]].
Finish the battle.
Save.
Give [[Sylvando]] a [[Pep pip]].
Start a new battle with the [[Luminary]], [[Erik]], [[Jade]] and [[Sylvando]].
Use the Haulellujah Pep Power.
Swap [[Erik]] out for [[Rab]].
Have the [[Luminary]] use [[Pep Up]] and [[Sylvando]] use a [[Pep pip]] on [[Jade]].
Use the [[Electro Light]] Pep Power; if it calls robots instead of metal slimes, reload your save.
On [[Rab]]'s next turn use [[Dirge of Dundrasil]] to put the slimes to sleep.
Finish them with critical-hit skills, not normal attacks, which can wake them up so they flee.

sections.check: At level 70+ one such fight can give at least 500,000 EXP to everyone; a [[Metal king slime]] (Vicious) then always drops a [[Pep pip]].

sections.title: How to farm gold in the final act
sections.need: You'll need: the third act with flight, [[Erik]] with [[Half-Inch]] and [[Sticky Fingers]] (Guile panels), ideally [[Robber gloves]] +3.

steps.t: Fly to The First Forest Whale Way Station, just north of Yggdrasil.
Fight [[Hooper duper]]s.
Use [[Half-Inch]] with [[Erik]] to steal their [[Devilry drinker]] shield.
Flee or finish the battle.
Repeat.
Sell each [[Devilry drinker]] for 30,000G.

sections.check: Your gold rises by 30,000G per shield sold; [[Hooper duper]]s also drop [[Seed of Sorcery]].

sections.title: How to farm stat seeds
sections.need: You'll need: drop-rate gear: two [[Bunny tail]]s per character, the [[Pirate king's pendant]] on [[Erik]].

steps.t: Equip the drop-rate gear; seeds are always a monster's rare drop.
Bring the source's ideal team: [[Erik]], [[Jade]], [[Veronica]] and [[Serena]].
Swap [[Veronica]] out for the [[Luminary]] to use the Haulellujah Pep Power, which makes the last three foes killed drop their rare items.
For [[Seed of life]], go south over the bridge from the Champs Sauvage (North) campsite at night.
Fight the [[Corpse corporal]]s there (up to three per battle).
For [[Seed of magic]]: in daytime on the Path to Trial Isle, fight the flying Vicious [[Terrornodon]]s.
For [[Seed of strength]]: fight [[Brownie]]s on Insula Incognita (Malicious ones in the last part).
For [[Seed of defence]]: fight [[Mosstodon]]s in the First Forest, south of the Arboria entrance.
For [[Seed of Sorcery]]: fight [[Hooper duper]]s (see the gold how-to).

sections.check: Seeds land in the bag after battle; use them from the Items menu.

sections.title: How to farm Bunny tails
sections.need: You'll need: early game access to the Heliodor Region; the [[Luminary]], [[Erik]] and [[Jade]] for Haulellujah.

steps.t: Go to the Heliodor Region campsite (first or second part of the game).
At night, attack sleeping groups of [[Bunicorn]]s (three or four together).
Steal the common drop with [[Half-Inch]] so only the [[Bunny tail]] is left to drop.
Once [[Jade]] joins, pep up the [[Luminary]], [[Erik]] and [[Jade]].
Use Haulellujah to guarantee rare drops from the last three foes.
If you are in the third act, hunt [[Spiked hare]]s on Insula Occidentalis instead; the tail is their common drop.

sections.check: Each [[Bunny tail]] adds 1% drop rate; eight equipped give 8%.

sections.title: How to collect and spend Mini Medals
sections.need: You'll need: a boat (both exchange points need one).

steps.t: Open every chest, pot and barrel; the Mini Medals tab lists all known spots.
Hand medals in at Puerto Valor for the first page of the Album de Medailles.
Hand the rest in at L'Academie de Notre Maitre des Medailles; the reward table is on the Mini Medals tab.
If you want more after the last reward, race in the Black Cup at Gallopolis (a Drustan Trials wish); every race pays one medal.
Or farm [[Umbra]]s at night in the Disciple's Trial - The Cruel Crypt.
Steal the [[Umbra]]s' medal with [[Erik]].

sections.check: The album page fills with stamps and each threshold reward is handed over.

sections.title: How to choose Draconian Quest options
sections.need: You'll need: a new game (options are only offered on the naming screen).

steps.t: Start a new game and, on the naming screen, press the button shown to open Draconian Quest.
Tick only the options you want; the Draconian tab lists all of them and which version has them.
If an option becomes too much, remove it at any church.
Know that a removed option cannot be turned back on without an older save or a new game.

sections.check: Each completed Draconian Quest earns a star next to the save file.
